title: Absorption cutoff and stationary singularities for rounded Gaussian random dynamical systems
summary: We study Gaussian random dynamical systems with coordinatewise $\tanh$ nonlinearity, where finite precision is modeled by nearest-grid rounding after each step. Gaussian symmetry reduces the dynamics to an exact Markov chain for the normalized squared radius. Rounding makes the origin absorbing, and the total variation distance to the absorbing equilibrium equals the survival probability of the absorption time.
